task: Fix issue #155: guards inside the semantic_bind_repair_child PostgreSQL function return a bare NULL, so bind_repair_child cannot distinguish a deadline or precondition rejection from a malformed payload and surfaces a misleading invalid_object ContractError; the mandatory disposable-exit PostgreSQL evidence run consequently flakes about one run in three under host load.
